The '''Imperial headquarters''' on [[Kabaira]] was located in the city of [[Eponte Spaceport]]. It was [[Skirmish on Kabaira|infiltrated]] by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Tere Metallo]] and a [[Identified Rebel|female Rebel]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] in order to rescue [[Matt Turhaya]] and captured Kabairan [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]].<ref name="Passages">{{JournalCite|7|Passages}}</ref>
